name: bing-webmaster-tools-mcp
description: Ask Claude about your Bing search performance, crawling, links, sitemaps and keywords.
long_description:
Read-only connector for Bing Webmaster Tools. Uses your own API key and runs entirely on your computer: Claude talks to the official Bing Webmaster API on your behalf and nothing goes through third-party servers.

Includes performance by query and page, query↔page breakdowns, traffic trends, crawl stats and issues, URL index status, sitemaps, inbound links and Bing keyword research.

api_key.title: Bing Webmaster Tools API key
api_key.description: Bing Webmaster Tools → Settings → API access → API Key → Generate. One key covers all your verified sites.
